test_description: Verify 'Last Write Wins' conflict resolution when syncing offline reading sessions
business_risk: Critical - Data corruption or loss leads to user churn
preconditions: User logged in; Device A offline with local changes; Device B online modifying same record
test_steps: 1. Device A (Offline): Update Session X (Time: T1); 2. Device B (Online): Update Session X (Time: T2 where T2 > T1); 3. Device B syncs; 4. Device A goes Online and syncs
expected_result: Server retains Device B state (T2); Device A overwrites local state with Server state
success_criteria: Data consistency across all devices; Zero data loss
